decision.reason: The new school report materially strengthens the research lead but does not securely identify Darai’s film. The current article is accurate and already distinguishes the commissioned film from the provider’s advertised model. Adding identity caveats now would interrupt its human production-and-audience thread without resolving the central film-specific gap.
